limitations: 63 sessions of one instrument are not broad market validation. Earlier aggregate backtests included some later dates; Sep1-4 were studied intensively. This is a newly separated chronological calibration study, not a pristine prospective test. Sparse trades and overlapping hypothetical labels do not support guaranteed future probabilities. No production promotion or tuning after seeing final-test outcomes.
score_semantics: Absolute score is estimated TP probability; sign is direction; tie is abstention.
